paras: The NBA signed a data-sharing deal with the <u>CFTC</u>, the US derivatives regulator, and named <g>Kalshi and Polymarket</g> its "preferred" prediction market exchanges.
They will share integrity data and report suspicious trades. <r>League and team staff can't trade NBA contracts.</r>
Baseball (MLB) and hockey (NHL) signed similar deals earlier this year.

items.l: NBA staff allowed to trade NBA contracts

paras: The NFL refused. In a Supreme Court filing it backed the states that say sports contracts are <r>gambling</r> and should fall under state law.
Three big federal court rulings have split, <r>two of them for the states</r>. The Supreme Court has been asked to decide who's in charge.
<u>Prediction markets are going mainstream. Who regulates them is still open.</u>
